analysis: The actual arena probe passed all 9 assertions. Morgana E spent exactly 70 mana, created a shield, and started its 14-second cooldown. An immediate cooldown recast preserved mana, cooldown, and shield. Q then spent exactly 55 mana, created one projectile, and started its 7-second cooldown. Inspected source charges mana once in Combat.BeginCast; DexArena.Cast delegates to it without another deduction. The reported failure was not reproduced, so no repair is justified by these observations.

scenario.title: Completed arena probe: listed mana costs and cooldown rejection
scenario.expectedBehavior: Successful casts charge the listed mana cost once. A rejected cooldown recast preserves mana and cooldown. The prior host execution passed all nine checks; these observations do not establish correctness for every ability.
